programmes.d: Trainee pilot Justin Kirkbride takes two friends on a sightseeing tour of the Rocky Mountains.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: A Day At The Beach
programmes.d: A young boy is attacked by a shark and comes close to death as surgeons battle to save his life.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Code Grenn In The ER
programmes.d: Doctors perform a chest incision while awaiting surgeons; an iguana is brought in following a car accident.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Short Circuited Heart
programmes.d: A young nurse collapses in the ER, and her co-workers must restart her heart. A young father brings his baby into the hospital convinced there are maggots in her hands. A witch doctor is called to the ER to exorcise a demon from a woman's liver.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Skewered Skydivers
programmes.d: Two skydivers, impaled by the same fence post, are rushed to the ER; multiple patrons from a dance club suddenly stop breathing and Dr. Jasper must determine the cause; a bride-to-be may miss her wedding after her finger gets stuck in a make-up jar.
A killer appears to be targeting the most vulnerable members of a community. With each death more brutal than the last, the police need to find this murderer before another life is lost.
A young woman is brutally murdered in her home and police are convinced they have let the suspect escape for good until decades later a new invention changes everything.

programmes.t: World's Most Evil Killers: Danville Neil
programmes.d: In 2022, Danville Neil was finally jailed for the brutal 1993 murders of a WWII veteran and his sister.
Railway Killers John Duffy and David Mulcahy killed three women and raped many more across a four-year period in the early 1980s.
Old friends embark on a 'guy's trip' to the remote wilderness of Utah, when disaster strikes.

In April 1999, three British climbers get caught in a snowstorm near the summit of Mt. McKinley. After a night in a cave, one climber develops snow blindness and another volunteer to go down to base camp but breaks both his legs in a fall.
A solo hiker in the Carpathian Mountains breaks his hip and femur when he is crushed by multiple avalanches.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Drama Mama
programmes.d: The real reason behind a teenager's bulging tummy and stomach pains shock nurses, doctors, and even her meddling Mom; a delirious man yelling for his "car", reveals clues about his own attempted murder; a college coed mysteriously stops breathing.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Coma Woman Surprise
programmes.d: Doctors must decide whether to put a hole in a teenager's head who has a serious head trauma to relieve pressure, or wait for more help.

programmes.t: Untold Stories of the ER: Chocolate Pudding
programmes.d: A psychiatric patient has an extreme love of chocolate pudding; a patient in anaphylactic shock may be allergic to his girlfriend; a man with a bizarrely swollen face must be convinced to get treatment.
A look at the appearance of severed body parts in random locations across London, England.
